title: Fix admin panel visibility and access request flow

requirements.text: After a user logs in with Internet Identity, the admin panel navigation link must be visible in the header/navigation for admin users. The admin panel should be accessible and render the LockerAccessRequestsPanel component showing all pending access requests.

quotes: no admin panel is not showing
no i cant see anything fix it

acceptanceCriteria: After logging in as admin, an 'Admin Panel' link is visible in the navigation
Clicking the Admin Panel link navigates to the admin page
The admin page renders LockerAccessRequestsPanel with a list of all access requests
Non-admin users do not see the Admin Panel link

requirements.text: When a member submits a locker access request, it must be persisted in the backend and retrievable by the admin. The LockerAccessRequestsPanel must display all submitted requests with the requester's principal, timestamp, and status, and allow the admin to approve or deny each request.

quotes: no i cant see anything fix it

acceptanceCriteria: Submitting a locker access request stores the request in the backend
Admin panel shows all submitted access requests with principal ID, timestamp, and status
Admin can click Approve to grant locker access to a member
Admin can click Deny to reject a member's request
Approved members can access the Member Locker
Denied members see an appropriate message when trying to access the locker

requirements.text: The LockerAccessGate component must correctly check whether the current authenticated user has been approved for locker access. If the user is not yet approved, show a clear UI to submit an access request. If already approved, render the locker content.

quotes: no i cant see anything fix it

acceptanceCriteria: Unauthenticated users are prompted to log in
Authenticated users without access see a 'Request Access' button
Users with a pending request see a 'Request Pending' status message
Users with denied access see a 'Access Denied' message
Approved users and admins see the locker content

constraints: Do not change the existing backend data types or storage maps unless required to fix the access request persistence bug
Do not modify files in frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui
nonGoals: Adding new locker sections or features
Changing the visual design or theme
Adding email or push notifications for access requests
